visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black tank top stands on a city sidewalk during the day, gesturing and talking expressively to the camera. Behind him is a traditional Taiwanese storefront with a blue awning and various signs. (2) The camera pans to show a close-up of a printed menu board on a wall, listing food items like steamed buns and rice milk with prices between 10 and 26 TWD. (3) The man is now seated at an outdoor table holding a large white steamed bun in his right hand. He smiles and gestures with two fingers while sitting in front of two bowls of white rice milk. (4) Scene shift to a different outdoor dining area where the man sits before two bowls of noodles and soup. He points toward the food while explaining the low prices. (5) An extreme close-up shows a pair of chopsticks lifting a large, glistening dumpling from a plate, dipping it into a small dish of soy sauce. (6) Another close-up features a spoon lifting a piece of dark pig blood from a bowl of soup, showcasing the texture. (7) The final phase shows the man seated with two other companions whose faces are covered by white cartoon rabbit graphics. They are eating a large spread of dumplings and soup. Red text overlays summarize the total cost of the day's meals.
